label_audit.methodology: Independent model-authored second annotation, not human annotation or human gold truth. The only substantive review inputs were author-policy.json and the new 160-case v3-candidates.json. Every case was read with its complete visible history, workspace description, selected search scope, and visible gold label. Review covered missing versus resolvable topics, authorization of research/implementation/measurement/feedback, latest restrictions overriding prior authorization, visible content versus unseen local materials, and colloquial operations. No model predictions, prior dataset examples, repository datasets, earlier reports or errors were read; no web access, classifier invocation, or execution of scenario tasks occurred. Corrections record substantive case-setting changes only; all cases receive the named reviewer and truthful provenance flags. Gold labels and all case texts remain unchanged. Paired search-scope corrections preserve per-intent scope counts. The cases hash was computed after all corrections and annotation updates using sha256(json.dumps(cases, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode()).
